name: WoobOS
description: FireRed, LeafGreen, Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald: the PC becomes a modern desktop in a monitor. It boots with the W, then shows a home screen of apps with a dock and a menu bar, made for touch and controllers and just as easy with a mouse and keyboard. Boxes, Items, Mail and Settings are its own apps, in seven languages; Oak's PC and the Hall of Fame open the game's own screens.
